result:
I implemented `WeakSet.prototype.delete` in `crates/kahvi-builtins/src/weak_set/prototype_delete.rs`, but I have not built or tested it. The shell tool was denied in this session, so `cargo build`, `./t262 built-ins/WeakSet/prototype/delete/`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt` never ran.

The implementation follows the spec steps, with each step as a comment above its code. It uses the existing `this_weak_set`, `can_be_held_weakly`, `collection_key` and `weak_set_table` helpers, and mirrors the sibling `prototype_add.rs`. It returns `false` for non-weakly-holdable values, and otherwise returns whether `OrderedTable::delete` removed the entry. No other files were changed, and no helpers were added.
